title: Eber (Heber)
summary: Son of Salah; father of Peleg and Joktan (Gen 10:25). Ussher notes he outlived Abraham and that the name "Hebrew" comes from him (§102).
description: Masoretic text: born AM 1723 (when his father was the age given in Gen 11), lived 464 years, died AM 2187. No CFAH paper dates this person; the sort year falls to Ussher.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 2281 BC (no higher-tier year available).

birth.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 278 (PDF p. 313)
birth.note: The 15th ed. (2002) Chronological Compendium prints this AM and no BC year. That entry is kept. This BC year is the 23rd ed. Appendix F figure.

birth.citation: Jones, Chronology of the Old Testament (15th ed., 2002), "Chronological Compendium", p. 1 ("Eber born when Salah was 30 ... 1723")
Gen 11:10–26 (Arphaxad AM 1658 = Shem's 100th year, two years after the Flood of AM 1656; each later birth adds the father's age at the named son)

birth.note: Agrees with Jordan's own published AM 1723.

birth.date: "he himself [Heber] being begotten by Sala when he was a hundred and thirty years old"
birth.note: Josephus (Whiston) has 130; the Masoretic text has 30 (Gen 11:14).

birth.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 782a
birth.note: Year cell "2406 1724 67". The third printed figure 67 is the column "Floud", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 464 at the end of the name is the lifespan he prints. His table also prints the death at World 2187. 1724 + 464 is not 2187. Both figures are left as printed.

birth.citation: Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology and Geography, History and Prophecy, 2nd ed., corrected and improved (London: C. J. G. & F. Rivington, 1830), vol. II, Synopsis of the Chronology, p. xxxii
birth.note: The parenthesis is the Hebrew age. The other age is the one he adopts. The last figure is his B.C. column. He prints Heber.

death.note: Not stated in the Jones sources read (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament 15th ed. 2002). Leave empty until verified.

death.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Third Age §102 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

death.date: "Eber outlived \"Abram the Hebrew [Eberite]\" 4 yrs. Jacob and Esau were 19 when Eber died."

death.note: Stated relative to Abraham; Jordan prints no AM figure for this death.
